name: Nuclear fission and its physical interpretation
summary: Hahn and Strassmann found unexpected lighter elements after bombarding uranium with neutrons, and Meitner and Frisch explained this as the uranium nucleus splitting in two.
description: Hahn and Strassmann’s unexpected chemical products were interpreted by Meitner and Frisch as division of a heavy atomic nucleus.
tier_reason: The discovered process supports subsequent nuclear physics, reactors and nuclear-energy systems over generations.
why: Chemical results that did not fit the expected heavier elements forced a new physical interpretation.
